blurb: Guided fly fishing for brook, brown, or rainbow trout on the Root and Whitewater rivers in Southeast Minnesota's driftless area. The day is tailored to your skill level and goals, including casting review for beginners and hatch discussions for advanced anglers. Equipment from Sage, Rio, Simms, and other pro programs is available, or you may bring your own.
